beats: Artem's parents wanted him to learn about his diabetes by playing a game.
But every simulator online used a generic kid's body — nothing matched his real doses.
So his dad built the game on a real Hovorka model instead of a generic one.
It's tuned to Artem's own insulin, his own weight, like a tutor who already read his chart.
Now the glucose curves match sheet 08.10 — his own doctor's worksheet.
